[[Sea snake]]s can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] by [[Vannaka]] at level 40 [[Slayer]] and level 50 [[Combat level|combat]] after the completion of [[Royal Trouble]]. They are found in the [[Miscellania and Etceteria Dungeon]], which can be entered during and after the quest. They attack with [[melee]] and are [[poison]]ous so [[antipoison]]s of any variety are strongly recommended. Both variants share the same drop table, although the hatchling drop regular [[bones]] whereas the young drop [[big bones]] (and by extension [[long bone|long]] and [[curved bone]]s).

[[Dwarven multicannon]]s can be used in the dungeon, although it is in single combat.
